sections.title: Welcome to the New Launcher!
items: Initial official release of the enhanced Minecraft Launcher system.
Brand new modern UI with dark mode support and premium aesthetics.
Integrated **What's New** system to keep track of every update.
Support for Minecraft Java & Bedrock Edition with profile management.

sections.title: Features & Improvements
items: Dynamic video background support for Game Hero sections.
Improved font rendering for pixel-accurate text displays.
Advanced log viewer and troubleshooting tools integrated into Settings.
Optimized game launching process for faster startup times.

sections.title: Technical Notes
items: Built using Tauri & React for a lightweight and secure experience.
Automatic backend synchronization for news and version data.
